claim: A CloudWatch alarm can notify an Amazon SNS topic, invoke a Lambda function, perform EC2 actions (stop, terminate, reboot, recover) when it is based on EC2 metrics, scale an Auto Scaling group, and create Systems Manager OpsItems or Incident Manager incidents; the Systems Manager actions are performed only when the alarm goes into ALARM state.

values.display: stopping, terminating, rebooting, or recovering an EC2 instance
